scope: Proposition 3.7 (Uniform plane moments for zero-total smearings) of the manuscript “Gaussian free-field limits of weighted integer Lipschitz heights” (preprints/Gaussian-free-field-limits-of-weighted-integer-Lipschitz-heights-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3dae0156982e5d20), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the infinite-volume increment law furnished by Proposition 2.9, every zero-total smearing (3.1) satisfies X u wuH(u) p ≤ Cp,A (1 ≤ p < ∞). (3.14) The constants are uniform in a ≥ 1 and the center. The same estimate holds for the increment law in a finite free simply connected triangulation containing B(z0, C0a), for a sufficiently large fixed C0.
